entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6173451477191225984: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.1765 +/- 0.0365 mas (same row, RUWE 1.94): 193.18 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 10.240, -9.205 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.561 +/- 0.043 solar radii from Doyle et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-131 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract). Mass 1.06 +/- 0.068 solar masses from Doyle et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-131 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract). Temperature 5990 +/- 50 K from Doyle et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-131 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,990 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 122173 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff3f0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 122173 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,990 K and log g 4.08 (u1 0.414, u2 0.287): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
